programme.desc: S1 E2 Manager Aaron and his staff go all out to open the company's new Thanet store on time, chocolate sculptress Rhona accepts the challenge of creating a showstopping centrepiece for the big launch.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen Specials
programme.desc: S1 E2 Hamely Halloween It's Halloween and Paula has some recipes with a spooky twist. She makes neep and cider soup, sausage cobbler, toffee apple pudding, and a Haleve Nicht feast.

programme.title: Nadiya's Cook Once Eat Twice
programme.desc: S1 E4 Impress for Less In this episode, Nadiya Hussain teaches us her tricks for easy entertaining without breaking the bank, with her impressive but wallet friendly recipes to impress guests.

programme.title: Jamie's Food Escapes
programme.desc: S1 E4 Venice Venice is not famous for its food, much of which has been spoilt by tourism, but Jamie goes off the tourist track to find the real regional food of Venice: rice, polenta, seafood and fresh vegetables. He meets aristocrats in a palazzo, and the lady prisoners who are growing vegetables behind bars in Guidecca.

programme.title: Air Fryers: Are They Worth It?
programme.desc: A revealing look at the latest must-have gadget. It's said they can cook, bake and even fry food three times cheaper, 20% faster and with 80% less oil. No wonder sales of air fryers have rocketed by 3000% over the last two years-it's the biggest revolution to hit our kitchens since the microwave!

programme.title: Rick Stein and the Japanese Ambassador
programme.desc: Rick Stein visits Japan to get a feel for its cuisine before creating a banquet at the invitation of the Japanese ambassador.

programme.title: The Lives of Others
programme.desc: In East Berlin in 1984, an agent of the secret police who is conducting surveillance on a writer and his lover finds himself becoming increasingly drawn into their lives.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E32 Classic film review series hosted by legends Margaret Pomeranz and David Stratton. In this episode they review The Art Of War, Shaft, The Terrorist, Charade, Frenzy, and Sex: The Anabel Chong Story.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E29 Enjoy these classic episodes of The Movie Show with Margaret Pomeranz and David Stratton, as they review the latest crop of movies and give us their rating out of 5-stars.

programme.title: Black Narcissus
programme.desc: This Powell and Pressburger classic is set in a community of nuns high in the Himalayas. Their spiritual aims are hampered by the arrival of a beautiful girl and a young general. As the two elope together, the nuns are left attributing blame to each other and, when a young child dies in their care, tensions begin to increase. Stars Deborah Kerr, David Farrar and Jean Simmons.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S13 E10 Michelle Pfeiffer Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Summerland
programme.desc: During World War II, a reclusive Englishwoman finds her life up-ended when a young evacuee from the London Blitz is left in her care. Initially resolving to be rid of him, she finds herself opening her heart in this moving story of womanhood, love and friendship.

programme.title: King of My Castle
programme.desc: Louis gets into mischief and spends his father's fortune. His father decides to teach him a lesson, to make him believe that he has landed in the time of Louis XIV.

programme.title: Oskars Kleid
programme.desc: When Ben's son decides to live as a girl from now on, his world is turned upside down and the relationship with his family is put to a severe test.

programme.title: Anton Chekhov 1890
programme.desc: Anton Chekhov, a humble Russian doctor, writes novels he sells to newspapers to feed his family. As his talent gets noticed by his peers, Chekhov even gains Tolstoy's admiration. But when his brother dies from tuberculosis, Chekhov, remorseful, decides to flee his escalading notoriety and travels to the penal colony of the Sakhalin Island, in Siberia, to write about the depraved society the convicts live in. This journey will inspire some of his most brilliant and famous pieces.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: On a train headed for England a group of travellers is delayed by an avalanche. He meets aristocrats in a palazzo, and the lady prisoners who are growing vegetables behind bars in Guidecca.

programme.title: Air Fryers: Are They Worth It?
programme.desc: A revealing look at the latest must-have gadget. It's said they can cook, bake and even fry food three times cheaper, 20% faster and with 80% less oil. No wonder sales of air fryers have rocketed by 3000% over the last two years-it's the biggest revolution to hit our kitchens since the microwave!

programme.title: Black Narcissus
programme.desc: This Powell and Pressburger classic is set in a community of nuns high in the Himalayas. Their spiritual aims are hampered by the arrival of a beautiful girl and a young general. As the two elope together, the nuns are left attributing blame to each other and, when a young child dies in their care, tensions begin to increase. Stars Deborah Kerr, David Farrar and Jean Simmons.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S13 E10 Michelle Pfeiffer Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Summerland
programme.desc: During World War II, a reclusive Englishwoman finds her life up-ended when a young evacuee from the London Blitz is left in her care. Initially resolving to be rid of him, she finds herself opening her heart in this moving story of womanhood, love and friendship.

programme.title: King of My Castle
programme.desc: Louis gets into mischief and spends his father's fortune. His father decides to teach him a lesson, to make him believe that he has landed in the time of Louis XIV.

programme.title: Oskars Kleid
programme.desc: When Ben's son decides to live as a girl from now on, his world is turned upside down and the relationship with his family is put to a severe test.

programme.title: Anton Chekhov 1890
programme.desc: Anton Chekhov, a humble Russian doctor, writes novels he sells to newspapers to feed his family. As his talent gets noticed by his peers, Chekhov even gains Tolstoy's admiration. But when his brother dies from tuberculosis, Chekhov, remorseful, decides to flee his escalading notoriety and travels to the penal colony of the Sakhalin Island, in Siberia, to write about the depraved society the convicts live in. This journey will inspire some of his most brilliant and famous pieces.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: On a train headed for England a group of travellers is delayed by an avalanche. Holed up in a hotel in a fictional European country, young Iris (Margaret Lockwood) befriends elderly Miss Froy (Dame May Whitty). When the train resumes, Iris suffers a bout of unconsciousness and wakes to find the old woman has disappeared. The other passengers ominously deny Miss Froy ever existed, so Iris begins to investigate with another traveller (Michael Redgrave) and, as the pair sleuth, romantic sparks fly.

programme.title: Callie & Son
programme.desc: Callie was a teenage mother in trouble. Fresh out of the delivery room, her son was taken from her and sold on the black-market.Vowing to find him some day, this is her story.

programme.desc: In 18th century France, the Marquise de Merteuil and the Vicomte de Valmont play a dangerous game of seduction.

Prone to anxiety and paranoia, he visits his longtime therapist who prepares him for his journey to visit his mother. But mayhem ensues on the eve of Beau's departure, spinning his life in a surreal new direction.

There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan's childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game's clutches. But to defeat Jumanji's encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game - before it finishes them.

But when his brother dies from tuberculosis, Chekhov, remorseful, decides to flee his escalading notoriety and travels to the penal colony of the Sakhalin Island, in Siberia, to write about the depraved society the convicts live in. This journey will inspire some of his most brilliant and famous pieces.

When the train resumes, Iris suffers a bout of unconsciousness and wakes to find the old woman has disappeared. The other passengers ominously deny Miss Froy ever existed, so Iris begins to investigate with another traveller (Michael Redgrave) and, as the pair sleuth, romantic sparks fly.

There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan's childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game's clutches. But to defeat Jumanji's encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game - before it finishes them.

programme.title: Big Food Bucket List

programme.title: Nadiya's Cook Once Eat Twice
programme.desc: S1 E4 Impress for Less In this episode, Nadiya Hussain teaches us her tricks for easy entertaining without breaking the bank, with her impressive but wallet friendly recipes to impress guests.

programme.title: Jamie's Food Escapes
programme.desc: S1 E4 Venice Venice is not famous for its food, much of which has been spoilt by tourism, but Jamie goes off the tourist track to find the real regional food of Venice: rice, polenta, seafood and fresh vegetables. He meets aristocrats in a palazzo, and the lady prisoners who are growing vegetables behind bars in Guidecca.

programme.title: Air Fryers: Are They Worth It?
programme.desc: A revealing look at the latest must-have gadget. It's said they can cook, bake and even fry food three times cheaper, 20% faster and with 80% less oil. No wonder sales of air fryers have rocketed by 3000% over the last two years-it's the biggest revolution to hit our kitchens since the microwave!

programme.title: Rick Stein and the Japanese Ambassador
programme.desc: Rick Stein visits Japan to get a feel for its cuisine before creating a banquet at the invitation of the Japanese ambassador.

programme.title: The Mind of a Chef

programme.title: The Lives of Others
programme.desc: In East Berlin in 1984, an agent of the secret police who is conducting surveillance on a writer and his lover finds himself becoming increasingly drawn into their lives.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E32 Classic film review series hosted by legends Margaret Pomeranz and David Stratton. In this episode they review The Art Of War, Shaft, The Terrorist, Charade, Frenzy, and Sex: The Anabel Chong Story.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: E29 Enjoy these classic episodes of The Movie Show with Margaret Pomeranz and David Stratton, as they review the latest crop of movies and give us their rating out of 5-stars.

programme.title: Black Narcissus
programme.desc: This Powell and Pressburger classic is set in a community of nuns high in the Himalayas. Their spiritual aims are hampered by the arrival of a beautiful girl and a young general. As the two elope together, the nuns are left attributing blame to each other and, when a young child dies in their care, tensions begin to increase. Stars Deborah Kerr, David Farrar and Jean Simmons.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: S13 E10 Michelle Pfeiffer Some of the biggest film stars in history rose to fame during the 'golden age' of Hollywood, in the early and mid-20th century. We profile some of these stars who became household names.

programme.title: Summerland
programme.desc: During World War II, a reclusive Englishwoman finds her life up-ended when a young evacuee from the London Blitz is left in her care. Initially resolving to be rid of him, she finds herself opening her heart in this moving story of womanhood, love and friendship.

programme.title: King of My Castle
programme.desc: Louis gets into mischief and spends his father's fortune. His father decides to teach him a lesson, to make him believe that he has landed in the time of Louis XIV.

programme.title: Oskars Kleid
programme.desc: When Ben's son decides to live as a girl from now on, his world is turned upside down and the relationship with his family is put to a severe test.

programme.title: Anton Chekhov 1890
programme.desc: Anton Chekhov, a humble Russian doctor, writes novels he sells to newspapers to feed his family. As his talent gets noticed by his peers, Chekhov even gains Tolstoy's admiration. But when his brother dies from tuberculosis, Chekhov, remorseful, decides to flee his escalading notoriety and travels to the penal colony of the Sakhalin Island, in Siberia, to write about the depraved society the convicts live in. This journey will inspire some of his most brilliant and famous pieces.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: On a train headed for England a group of travellers is delayed by an avalanche. Holed up in a hotel in a fictional European country, young Iris (Margaret Lockwood) befriends elderly Miss Froy (Dame May Whitty). When the train resumes, Iris suffers a bout of unconsciousness and wakes to find the old woman has disappeared. The other passengers ominously deny Miss Froy ever existed, so Iris begins to investigate with another traveller (Michael Redgrave) and, as the pair sleuth, romantic sparks fly.

programme.title: Callie & Son
programme.desc: Callie was a teenage mother in trouble. Fresh out of the delivery room, her son was taken from her and sold on the black-market.Vowing to find him some day, this is her story.

programme.title: Dangerous Liaisons
programme.desc: In 18th century France, the Marquise de Merteuil and the Vicomte de Valmont play a dangerous game of seduction.

programme.title: Beau Is Afraid
programme.desc: Beau lives alone in a downtown apartment where every moment is a waking nightmare. Prone to anxiety and paranoia, he visits his longtime therapist who prepares him for his journey to visit his mother. But mayhem ensues on the eve of Beau's departure, spinning his life in a surreal new direction.

programme.desc: A story of love and murder told through the jaded voice of a child and expressive images of nature. Bill, a fugitive from the slums of Chicago, finds himself pitted against a shy, rich Texan for the love of Abby.

Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Robin Williams and Kirsten Dunst star in this blockbuster hit and critical favourite that combines magical special effects with an entrancing mix of fantasy, adventure and comedy. Young Alan Parrish sits down as a young boy to play a game with his friend, Sarah, and on a roll of the dice is mysteriously transported into the strange jungle realm of Jumanji. There he remains trapped for 26 years, until two newly orphaned children, Judy (Dunst) and Peter (Bradley Pierce), playing in the attic of Alan's childhood home, free the now-adult Alan (Williams) from the game's clutches. But to defeat Jumanji's encroaching powers, the three reluctant players must find the now-grown Sarah (Bonnie Hunt) and band together as a makeshift family to finish the game - before it finishes them.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: S3 E3 Easy, clever, and full of flavour- these quick Italian dishes are designed to beat the midweek slump and bring joy back to the dinner table.

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: S1 E5 Eton Mess Global food explorer Adam is touring Britain, one incredible, edible place at a time, using the map as his menu to visit places in Britain that have given their name to world-famous dishes. He's arrived in Eton to taste the famous culinary mash-up, Eton Mess. He also has a right Royal Afternoon Tea in Windsor, as well as some delicious venison bon bons.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for Mexico
programme.desc: S1 E1 Mexico City Eva Longoria shows us around her adopted second hometown, Mexico City. This is where she met her husband, Pepe, and where they love to spend time with their son, Santi. She takes us on her daily ritual to a local bakery where she devours a delicious, freshly baked concha. Then, Eva heads to the historic centre to meet up with food writer Gabriela Renteria where they sample the 'lifeblood' of Mexico City - tacos.

programme.title: A Taste of Island Dreams
programme.desc: S1 E1 Lemon Chilli Chicken with Turmeric Rice Learn to cook a signature dish at Island Dreams Cafe and an all-round family favourite. Alimah Bilda shares a version with a punchier, thicker sauce that coats the chicken and rice.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: S20 E3 Liverpool: Steph It's night three in Liverpool where singing hairdresser Steph is attempting to win over her guests with an evening of Spanish food.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: S20 E4 Liverpool: Lisa This week's competition comes from in and around Liverpool, where fourth up is coffee shop worker Lisa, who intends to treat her guests to the delicious flavours of Mexico.

programme.desc: S3 E30 Lemon Myrtle And Pizzas The little village of Nimbin, in the Byron Bay Hinterland, has embraced its reputation as Australia's hippie capital and the influence of the counter culture extends way beyond the colourful main street.

programme.title: Big Food Bucket List

programme.title: Who Do You Think You Are? UK
programme.desc: S18 E12 Anna Maxwell Martin Being a mum is a massive part of Motherland star Anna Maxwell Martin's life. She's interested in what kinds of parents there were in the family before her, and how this has shaped her own life and the kind of parent she is to her own daughters. Travelling to the small town in Northern Ireland where her father grew up, her understanding of her grandparents who suffered a heartbreaking family tragedy is turned on its head. On her mother's side, Anna starts with her twinkly grandfather Maxwell, whose name she added to her own to create her stage name. Looking into his childhood, she uncovers a dark history of domestic abuse and family separation. But she also discovers extraordinary familial solidarity and love, which changed the pattern for the generations that followed.

programme.desc: S3 E5 Episode 5 The outback is one of the world's last wild frontiers and, for the giant trucks who roam this epic, harsh country, there's only one way to get from A to B - the hard way. Whether it's taking on scorching deserts, or battling torrential rains that turn roads into rivers, this is a land that can destroy in a heartbeat. For the men and women who risk their rigs and their lives to face it, this punishing wilderness is a home away from home. We hit the road train again for lots of dirt and dangers, joining some of the toughest, most skilled truckers on the planet, as they haul their massive loads through hell on Earth. Without them, Australia would grind to a halt. Their mission: to get their freight in and their trucks out. programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: S9 E9 Hell Freezes Over For two months out of every year, a group of exceptional men find their way to the Canadian tundra to undertake one of the most dangerous jobs on earth. In the thick of winter, truckers in giant eighteen wheelers carry vital equipment and supplies to miners hundreds of miles away. In blizzard conditions, these truckers travel over ice roads that often take them over frozen lakes. Each man is trained in self survival, from fixing his truck in sub zero conditions in seconds to escaping from a truck if the ice cracks. On the other end of the journey are miners whose lives depend on the truckers making it to their base, year after year. The episodes will form a narrative arch - taking the viewer on a journey from when the experienced and novice truckers first sign up for the season, to the last truck making it back to base.

programme.title: Outback Truckers
programme.desc: S3 E6 Episode 6 The outback is one of the world's last wild frontiers and, for the giant trucks who roam this epic, harsh country, there's only one way to get from A to B - the hard way. Whether it's taking on scorching deserts, or battling torrential rains that turn roads into rivers, this is a land that can destroy in a heartbeat. For the men and women who risk their rigs and their lives to face it, this punishing wilderness is a home away from home. We hit the road train again for lots of dirt and dangers, joining some of the toughest, most skilled truckers on the planet, as they haul their massive loads through hell on Earth. Without them, Australia would grind to a halt. Their mission: to get their freight in and their trucks out. In this episode, Jonny Rayner faces a difficult choice as he decides whether to cross a crocodile-infested river or delay his journey.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: S9 E10 Icy Alliance For two months out of every year, a group of exceptional men find their way to the Canadian tundra to undertake one of the most dangerous jobs on earth. In the thick of winter, truckers in giant eighteen wheelers carry vital equipment and supplies to miners hundreds of miles away. In blizzard conditions, these truckers travel over ice roads that often take them over frozen lakes. Each man is trained in self survival, from fixing his truck in sub zero conditions in seconds to escaping from a truck if the ice cracks. On the other end of the journey are miners whose lives depend on the truckers making it to their base, year after year. The episodes will form a narrative arch - taking the viewer on a journey from when the experienced and novice truckers first sign up for the season, to the last truck making it back to base.

programme.title: Mary Berry at 90: A Lifetime of Cooking
programme.desc: S1 E4 Alex Jones Dame Mary's dear friend, broadcaster Alex Jones, joins her in the kitchen to celebrate how Mary's friends and family - and, of course, the viewers - have been at the heart of her cooking for 60 years. Along with Alex, who is an enthusiastic but still nervous cook, Mary is also joined by her right-hand woman of 35 years, Lucy Young. Lucy, a trained cook, came to work with Mary straight from college and has been essential to recipe testing, writing books and running her office ever since. To honour both these women, Mary has decided to bring out the big guns. Out of the thousands of recipes Mary has written over the years, she is going to cook the ones she is asked for time and time again, including her cheesy mushroom and spinach lasagne, a reinvention of her 1970s chocolate cake, her husband Paul's favourite cheesy nutter snacks, and the nation's all-time favourite, Mary's Victoria sandwich.

programme.desc: S1 E1 From The Water Maeve O'Meara journeys into the top end of Australia to seek out wild barramundi with local fisherman Billy Boustead and his chef friend, legendary Darwin and Alice springs restaurateur Jimmy shu. After visiting one of the world great seafood trading floors- the Sydney Fish Market with De Costi's chief buyer Carmelo Lombardo, renowned seafood chef Steve Hodges shares some of the secrets of cooking fish perfectly. Alberto Fava makes his inspired signature dish of squid ink tagliolini and calamari with salmon roe and bottarga. The bounty of the water includes the creation of perfect sea salt, using salt water, sun and wind at Olsson's in Spencer Gulf South Australia where salt has been produced since the 1940's... sea salt and rock salt then used in a classic Sicilian recipe for whole baked snapper in a salt crust from chef Lino Sauro.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: S7 E39 Marathon Man On February 14, 2000, Bob Dorotik's body was found on a mountain road near his family's horse ranch. His wife told police that Bob had gone jogging and never returned, but investigators had their doubts. He had been beaten and strangled, and it appeared that someone else had dressed him. Authorities began tracing the crime back to the family's ranch, leading them to think Bob Dorotik didn't leave home alone. His wife told police that Bob had gone jogging and never returned, but investigators had their doubts. He had been beaten and strangled, and it appeared that someone else had dressed him. Authorities began tracing the crime back to the family's ranch, leading them to think Bob Dorotik didn't leave home alone.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: S9 E15 Pinned By The Evidence After a street fight took the life of a national wrestling champion, police had to determine if he was killed in cold blood, or in self-defence. A jury decided it was murder and sentenced the accused to a minimum of 20 years in prison. Six years later, he was granted another trial, and a forensic animator, who testified on his behalf, offered a different explanation for the most damning piece of evidence.

programme.title: The First 48
programme.desc: S19 E11 1000 Cuts / Draw In medicine, they call it the 'critical hour', in criminal investigations, they call it the 'first 48 hours'. Ask any detective - they will tell you that if they don't have a lead, a suspect or an arrest within 48 hours, their chances of solving the case are cut in half. In a visual style that feels more like a TV drama than a verite reality show, this program follows homicide detectives during these initial critical hours as they race against time to solve their cases. The program follows various detectives of a few select homicide teams as they track breaking cases - each with a running clock that builds pace as the 48 hours inexorably expires. In this episode, an innocent mother is viciously murdered with a butcher knife. In Atlanta, a beloved patriarch is gunned down when a game of dominoes turns deadly.

programme.title: Killer Cases
programme.desc: S4 E2 Death By Antifreeze Outwardly, Mark Jensen seemed to be a mild-mannered, loving husband, grieving over the suicide death of his wife. When police found traces of antifreeze in her autopsy, they started to question everything.

programme.title: Death Row Stories
programme.desc: S3 E6 Clarence \ In 1983, Clarence 'Smitty' Smith, the regional president of a notorious biker club, The Outlaws, was accused of a quadruple homicide in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. The state's case rested on the testimony of the sole survivor of the massacre, Penny Reid, however the jury found her unreliable and Smitty was acquitted of all charges. Thus began a decades-long battle between Smitty and Federal Government. Three months after his Fort Lauderdale trial, Smitty was again arrested, this time for the car bombing of a federal witness in New Orleans. The murder, which had occurred several years prior, had gone unsolved up to that point. But two members of the Outlaws, facing long prison sentences themselves, came forward saying Smitty had committed the murder. In 1985, Smitty was again put on trial for his life. After a two-day trial, he was sentenced to death.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: S10 E1 Killer Cougars What turns women into murderers? Are the seeds sown in their childhood? Do they develop into cold-hearted killers because of greed, jealousy, or just for kicks? This series explores the psychology of real-life murderesses to find the answers. programme.title: Who Do You Think You Are? UK
programme.desc: S18 E12 Anna Maxwell Martin Being a mum is a massive part of Motherland star Anna Maxwell Martin's life. She's interested in what kinds of parents there were in the family before her, and how this has shaped her own life and the kind of parent she is to her own daughters. Travelling to the small town in Northern Ireland where her father grew up, her understanding of her grandparents who suffered a heartbreaking family tragedy is turned on its head. On her mother's side, Anna starts with her twinkly grandfather Maxwell, whose name she added to her own to create her stage name. Looking into his childhood, she uncovers a dark history of domestic abuse and family separation. But she also discovers extraordinary familial solidarity and love, which changed the pattern for the generations that followed.

programme.title: Who Do You Think You Are? UK
programme.desc: S18 E12 Anna Maxwell Martin Being a mum is a massive part of Motherland star Anna Maxwell Martin's life. She's interested in what kinds of parents there were in the family before her, and how this has shaped her own life and the kind of parent she is to her own daughters. Travelling to the small town in Northern Ireland where her father grew up, her understanding of her grandparents who suffered a heartbreaking family tragedy is turned on its head. On her mother's side, Anna starts with her twinkly grandfather Maxwell, whose name she added to her own to create her stage name. Looking into his childhood, she uncovers a dark history of domestic abuse and family separation. But she also discovers extraordinary familial solidarity and love, which changed the pattern for the generations that followed.

programme.title: Mary Berry at 90: A Lifetime of Cooking
programme.desc: S1 E4 Alex Jones Dame Mary's dear friend, broadcaster Alex Jones, joins her in the kitchen to celebrate how Mary's friends and family - and, of course, the viewers - have been at the heart of her cooking for 60 years. Along with Alex, who is an enthusiastic but still nervous cook, Mary is also joined by her right-hand woman of 35 years, Lucy Young. Lucy, a trained cook, came to work with Mary straight from college and has been essential to recipe testing, writing books and running her office ever since. To honour both these women, Mary has decided to bring out the big guns. Out of the thousands of recipes Mary has written over the years, she is going to cook the ones she is asked for time and time again, including her cheesy mushroom and spinach lasagne, a reinvention of her 1970s chocolate cake, her husband Paul's favourite cheesy nutter snacks, and the nation's all-time favourite, Mary's Victoria sandwich.

After visiting one of the world great seafood trading floors- the Sydney Fish Market with De Costi's chief buyer Carmelo Lombardo, renowned seafood chef Steve Hodges shares some of the secrets of cooking fish perfectly. Alberto Fava makes his inspired signature dish of squid ink tagliolini and calamari with salmon roe and bottarga. programme.title: Mary Berry at 90: A Lifetime of Cooking
programme.desc: S1 E4 Alex Jones Dame Mary's dear friend, broadcaster Alex Jones, joins her in the kitchen to celebrate how Mary's friends and family - and, of course, the viewers - have been at the heart of her cooking for 60 years. Along with Alex, who is an enthusiastic but still nervous cook, Mary is also joined by her right-hand woman of 35 years, Lucy Young. Lucy, a trained cook, came to work with Mary straight from college and has been essential to recipe testing, writing books and running her office ever since. To honour both these women, Mary has decided to bring out the big guns. Out of the thousands of recipes Mary has written over the years, she is going to cook the ones she is asked for time and time again, including her cheesy mushroom and spinach lasagne, a reinvention of her 1970s chocolate cake, her husband Paul's favourite cheesy nutter snacks, and the nation's all-time favourite, Mary's Victoria sandwich.
